summary: Completed comprehensive testing of monthly budget app with INR currency. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate). Critical modal dialog issue identified preventing sequential transaction additions. Navigation, theme toggle, mobile responsiveness, and currency formatting working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal dialog overlay intercepts pointer events after first transaction submission, preventing sequential transaction additions without page reload
ui_bugs.impact: Blocks core functionality - users cannot add multiple transactions in sequence

integration_issues.issue: Dialog does not close properly after transaction submission, blocking subsequent interactions

passed_tests: INR currency format display (₹ symbol present)
Navigation between pages (Dashboard, Transactions, Budgets, Savings, Analytics, Settings)
Edit and delete button visibility on hover
Transaction form validation and category selection
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix modal dialog state management in transaction form. The dialog overlay remains active after form submission, preventing users from adding multiple transactions in sequence. This breaks the core user workflow. The issue is in the onOpenChange handler and dialog state reset logic.
